title: Managing pollen during outdoor activity
body: Check pollen forecasts before outdoor exercise. Consider pre-treatment per your action plan, warm up indoors, and shower after exposure to reduce allergen load.

title: Sleep and asthma recovery
body: Adequate sleep supports immune regulation and recovery. Poor sleep the night before activity may increase perceived breathlessness and symptom sensitivity.

title: Exercise with asthma
body: Most people with asthma can exercise safely with proper warm-up and controller therapy. Reduce intensity if cough, wheezing, or chest tightness increase during activity.

title: Symptom monitoring
body: Track daytime and nighttime symptoms, activity limitation, and rescue inhaler use daily. Patterns over several days are more informative than a single reading.

title: Indoor trigger reduction
body: Reduce dust mites and indoor allergens with regular cleaning, HEPA filtration where appropriate, and avoiding smoke or strong chemical irritants.
